buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 4. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid

document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 5. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 6. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 7. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 8. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 9. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 10. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. Eligibility of Bidders: Only Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) or their duly authorized dea lers shall be eligible to participate in the bidding process. Dealers participating on behalf of an OEM must submit a valid Manufacturer Authorization Certificate (MAF) specifically mentioning the relevant tender. 2. Registered Office and Statutory Compliance: The bidder must have an established and duly re gistered office in Kerala and possess a valid Goods and Services Tax (GST) registration issued by th e Government of India. A valid local trade licence in accordance with applicable Kerala State laws is also mandatory. Copies of all relevant registration certificates and statutory documents must be sub mitted along with the bid for verification. 3. GST Registration and Filing Compliance: The bidder's GST registration must be aligned with the state jurisdiction of both the consignee and the bid-inviting authority, wherever applicable. The GST

registration certificate must clearly indicate the name of the bidding entity. Documentary evidence of regular monthly GST return filings for the preceding three years must also be submitted. 4. Product Status and Manufacturer Support: All products offered must be brand-new, current-ge neration models, actively supported by the respective manufacturer, and in continuous production. The bidder must submit an undertaking confirming that none of the quoted products have been decl ared End-of-Life (EOL), discontinued, or withdrawn from the manufacturer's product portfolio. 5. GeM Portal Experience: The bidder must have been actively registered and engaged in business activities through the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal for a minimum period of three years. Relevant documentary evidence establishing the period of registration and business activity must b e submitted along with the bid. 6. GeM Rating and Customer Feedback: The bidder must possess a minimum rating of 4 stars on t he GeM portal. The bidder must also demonstrate consistently positive user and buyer feedback, pr eferably reflecting 5-star ratings. Additionally, the bidder must possess a valid GeM Gold Certificate. Documentary evidence supporting the GeM rating, customer feedback, and certification must be fur nished along with the bid. 7. Acceptance of Additional Terms and Conditions: The bidder must expressly accept all Addition al Terms and Conditions (ATCs) prescribed for this procurement. A duly signed acceptance letter on the bidder's official company letterhead, in accordance with the requirements of the bid-inviting aut hority, must be submitted along with the bid. 8. Mandatory OEM Certifications: The respective OEM must possess a valid ISO 9001 certification a nd BIS Factory License (FG Licence), wherever applicable to the product category. Copies of valid ce rtificates and licences must be submitted along with the bid for verification. 9. Declaration Regarding Blacklisting: The bidder must submit a formal undertaking on its official company letterhead, duly signed by an authorized signatory, declaring that the bidder has not been blacklisted, debarred, or banned by any Government department, public sector undertaking, or publ ic procurement authority during the preceding three years. 10. Compliance with Technical Specifications: All products offered must strictly conform to the tec hnical specifications, including the specified make, model, and manufacturer datasheet requirement s, as prescribed in the tender document. Any deviation or non-compliance with the stipulated techni cal specifications shall render the bid liable for rejection during the technical evaluation process. 11. Relevant Government Supply Experience: The bidder must possess proven experience in suppl ying similar products to Central or State Government departments, Government institutions, or Publ ic Sector Undertakings (PSUs). The bidder must submit a valid ISO 9001:2015 certificate, along with relevant financial statements and supporting financial documents duly certified by a Chartered Acco untant (CA), as evidence of eligibility and financial credibility. 12. Brand Reputation and Market Standing: The brands offered must have an established reputati on for quality, reliability, durability, and performance. Preference may be given to brands having a s trong market presence, proven product performance, and consistently positive customer and user f eedback. 13. Previous Supply Experience in Kerala: The bidder must demonstrate a proven track record of s upplying similar products manufactured by the quoted OEM to Government departments, Governme nt institutions, or Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) within Kerala through the GeM portal during the preceding three years. Copies of relevant purchase orders, supply records, and completion certificat es must be submitted as supporting evidence. 14. Service and Support Infrastructure in Kerala: The bidder must maintain an established service and support mechanism within Kerala to ensure prompt resolution of product-related complaints an d technical issues. The service arrangement must ensure that reported product breakdowns are att ended to and appropriate technical support is provided within a maximum period of 24 hours from t he time of complaint registration. 15. Service Support Escalation Matrix: The bidder or the respective OEM must submit a comprehen sive service support escalation matrix containing the names, designations, email addresses, and co ntact telephone numbers of the concerned service personnel and escalation authorities. 16. Technical Deviation Statement: Any deviations from the technical specifications or general term s and conditions prescribed in the tender must be clearly identified and disclosed in a separate Tech

nical Deviation Statement submitted along with the bid. Failure to disclose any such deviations shall be treated as non-compliance with the tender requirements. 17. Live Product Demonstration: The bidder shall arrange and conduct a live demonstration of the q uoted products before the consignee or the designated evaluation committee, as and when schedul ed by the purchaser. Failure to conduct the demonstration within the stipulated time or in accordan ce with the prescribed requirements shall result in disqualification of the bid. 18. OEM Customer Support Facility: The OEM must provide a dedicated customer support helpline o r toll-free telephone number, along with an online service and complaint-registration portal, for addr essing product-related issues. Details of the customer support facilities and a comprehensive servic e escalation matrix must be included in the bid documentation. .
